name: Marian University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic university in Indianapolis, IN. Offers a broad range of undergraduate programs; recognized regionally as a comprehensive Catholic institution with strong pre-professional and health sciences offerings.
financial_aid: Over 99 percent of first-time, full-time Marian University students receive financial aid. Institutional scholarships and need-based aid available. Tuition and fees approx $43,400/year (2025-26 basis); total on-campus cost with room and board approx $58,440.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the MU Softball Field (also referenced as the MU Softball Diamond) on the Marian University campus in Indianapolis, IN.
program_reputation: Nationally competitive NAIA program in the Crossroads League; ranked #10 in NAIA softball at time of research (2026-07).
notes: Data sourced from muknights.com softball staff and roster pages and marian.edu tuition page (checked 2026-07). Roster size 23 from 2027 roster page. Team X/Twitter account is @MarianKnightsSB; no individual coach handles listed.
